system_context.affinity_note: macOS exposes no hard thread-to-core affinity (no sched_setaffinity; thread_policy_set affinity tags are ignored on Apple Silicon), so each worker thread only sets QoS USER_INTERACTIVE (pthread_set_qos_class_self_np), which steers it towards the P-cores; placement is still decided by the scheduler
